summary: Frontend-only validation of Resume Playback feature (web preview, 390x844). ALL 8 acceptance criteria PASS. localStorage 'last_playback_state' has the exact shape {trackId, queueIds[], originalQueueIds[], isShuffled, positionMillis, savedAt} and updates during playback. Pause writes the exact current position to LS (verified UI 0:13 matches LS 13814ms). Reload restores the mini-player paused at the saved position with the play (not pause) icon, time does not advance until user taps play, and playback resumes from the saved position. Next/Previous work correctly after restore in both non-shuffled and shuffled queues. Shuffle state and shuffled queue order are correctly persisted and restored. Regressions clean: favorites heart toggle in mini-player still works (glyph f377 -> f36a and persists to localStorage 'favorites'), search finds 'Rocky Top', Library tab renders 'My Playlists' UI. No AudioPlayerContext/playbackStateStorage-related console errors. Only pre-existing warnings observed (expo-av deprecation, non-route file warnings for utility files under app/, textShadow/shadow/pointerEvents/resizeMode deprecations, React 19 element.ref access) — none introduced by this feature.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated package still in use. Should migrate to expo-audio for audio playback per Expo SDK 54. Reference: /app/frontend/app/contexts/AudioPlayerContext.web.tsx:2 and package.json. Pre-existing, not introduced by Resume Playback.

Utility/context/constants files placed under app/ trigger 'missing default export' warnings for AddToPlaylistModal.tsx, MiniPlayer.tsx, musicData.ts, AudioPlayerContext.tsx, AudioPlayerContext.web.tsx, playbackStateStorage.ts, playlistStorage.ts, shareTrack.ts, etc. Non-fatal but pollutes logs. Recommend moving out of app/. Reference: /app/frontend/app/utils/playbackStateStorage.ts (new file also under app/). Pre-existing pattern.

action_items: None required for the Resume Playback feature — ship it. All 8 acceptance criteria verified on web preview.
OPTIONAL (unchanged from prior iterations): migrate expo-av -> expo-audio, and move non-route files (including the new playbackStateStorage.ts) out of app/ to silence expo-router warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: playbackStateStorage.ts: correct shape, guards for malformed data (typeof trackId==='string' && Array.isArray(queueIds)), silently drops missing tracks via resolveTracks. GOOD.

AudioPlayerContext.web.tsx.persistState: writes on playTrack(0), on periodic 5s tick during playback, on pause with exact position, and on didJustFinish end-of-queue with 0. Uses refs to avoid stale closures. GOOD.

AudioPlayerContext.web.tsx.restoreSession: called on mount, loads state, resolves tracks, creates Sound with shouldPlay:false and the saved positionMillis — matches the user choice 'restored track appears paused, NOT auto-playing'. GOOD.
Fallback when the exact saved trackId is missing from the queue: savedIndex<0 -> index=0 and positionMillis=0. Correct.
originalQueueIds falls back to tracks when the resolved original list is empty — prevents lost original order when tracks are removed. GOOD.

shufflePlaylist does NOT persist immediately; state is persisted on the next periodic tick or next control action (pause/next/prev/track-end). Verified this still works in practice because playback continues and the 5s tick saves the new isShuffled+queueIds. Consider persisting explicitly inside shufflePlaylist for immediate durability in case the user closes the app within <5s of shuffling.
seed_data_creation: Started each session by clearing localStorage. Ran full flow (play->pause->reload->play->next->prev, then shuffle->reload->next, then favorites toggle) in a single browser session.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Web preview uses AudioPlayerContext.web.tsx (expo-av HTMLAudio). Mini-player controls row is the parent of the /^\d:\d\d$/ time text with exactly 5 children in order [heart, previous, play/pause, next, timeText]. Click via page.mouse.click(x,y) on centers computed from getBoundingClientRect — TouchableOpacity has no role=button so get_by_role('button') will NOT work. Shuffle icon lives in collection header (y<100, x>300 for 390-wide viewport). localStorage key for resume is 'last_playback_state'; for favorites 'favorites'; for playlists 'user_playlists'. Native react-native-track-player path is NOT testable in web preview (AudioPlayerContext.native.tsx untested here).
rca_of_issue: N/A - this iteration validates a NEW FEATURE (Resume Playback), no bug fix. Verification steps: (1) played Rocky Top for 14s, LS updated to {trackId, queueIds[20], originalQueueIds[20], isShuffled:false, positionMillis:10015, savedAt:...}; (2) tapped pause, LS positionMillis updated to 13814 matching UI 0:13; (3) reloaded page - mini-player shows Rocky Top with play glyph (0xf4cd = play-circle) at 0:13, waited 3.5s, time unchanged confirming no auto-play; (4) tapped play, time advanced 0:13 -> 0:17 in 3.5s confirming resume from saved position; (5) Next advanced queueIndex 17->18 (sep26-track-19), Previous returned to 17; (6) played Beat It, tapped shuffle, waited 7s -> LS isShuffled=true with reshuffled queueIds starting with current track (sep26-track-2), reloaded -> restored to same track with isShuffled=true and identical queueIds, Next advanced index 0->1 in shuffled order; (7) favorites heart glyph flipped f377 (heart-outline) -> f36a (heart-filled) and LS 'favorites' contains the current track id; search input accepts text and returns 'Rocky Top' match; Library tab renders 'My Playlists / 0 playlists / Create Playlist' correctly. (8) No AudioPlayerContext or playbackStateStorage errors in console — only pre-existing React 19 ref warning and expo warnings.
